Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form — audit and pen test logistics

Jordan — good questions, thanks for sending the questionnaire. High level answers and a proposed ops plan below; attaching a draft exhibit for legal to review.

1) SOC 2 scope
- Redwood will commit to SOC 2 Type II covering Security and Availability (controls mapped to CC1/CC2). Detailed assertion mapping is in the attached draft.

2) Pen test notice and scope
- Proposed: 45-day calendar notice for external pentests (we've found this balances vendor scheduling and remediation runway).
- We can offer ephemeral, scoped staging credentials for tests that require internal access; otherwise external-only (IP-limited) testing is acceptable. All pentests require an agreed test plan and a kill-switch contact.

3) Evidence cadence
- Recommended: weekly evidence shipments for the first 60 days post-execution, then monthly for the next 4 months, then quarterly thereafter. We can provide a dashboard link and zipped evidence packages (S3 presigned) per delivery. If your auditor requires a different tempo, tell us which items must be in the weekly bucket vs monthly.

4) Order form redlines to expect
- We will propose: scoped inspection rights (sampled systems + timeboxed windows), mutual NDA on forensic artifacts, liability carveouts for customer-supplied data, and an acknowledgment of Redwood's right to sanitize logs to protect other customers. Laura — please review redline language.

Next steps:
- Laura/legal to provide redline suggestions on the attached PDF.
- Rishi/ops to confirm running playbooks for ephemeral creds and canary rollback runbook.
- Jordan — let us know if Valence prefers 30-day notice instead of 45; we'll mark up the Order Form accordingly.

Attachments: redwood_proposed_security_exhibit_draft.pdf

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Jordan / Kimberly / Rishi,

Thanks — I reviewed the draft exhibit and Rishi's ops redline. A few legal clarifications and proposed final language so procurement can close this quickly:

1) Inspection / Audit Rights (proposed language)
- "Customer may request inspections limited to predefined sample sets and within mutually agreed 5 business day windows. Redwood will not permit unfettered forensic access to multi-tenant production environments; any production-level forensic activity requires prior written approval and joint post-test remediation plan."

2) Penetration Test Notice & Controls
- We accept 45-day notice. Tests must be performed against a scoping document attached to the Order Form which lists endpoints, IPs, and any in-scope staging environments. Ephemeral creds issued for testing must expire automatically after 72 hours. Redwood will provide a 24/7 kill-switch contact.

3) Evidence / Deliverables cadence
- We will commit to the operational cadence Kimberly proposed with two refinements: (a) initial 60-day weekly shipments limited to diagnostic artifacts (config, control evidence, aggregated logs), and (b) redact any customer-identifying data from shared artifacts. If Valence needs raw forensic logs containing PII, that will require a separate ingestion agreement.

4) Liability & Forensic Artifacts
- Add an NDA carveout for forensic artifacts and limit retention to the duration necessary to address the test findings (we propose 90 days default retention unless otherwise agreed).

If that language is acceptable to Valence, Kimberly — please upload the marked exhibit to the Drive link and Jordan / procurement can accept or propose modifications. Suggest a target close: June 7, 2026 to have exhibit + order form redlines agreed.

Regards,
Laura Bennett | Senior Counsel, Contracts & Security
Redwood Inference
